summary_paragraph: The patient, a man with nonischemic cardiomyopathy and type 1 diabetes, was admitted for worsening shortness of breath after running out of Lasix. Initially treated for heart failure, he was found to have multifocal pneumonia on CT imaging. He developed septic shock, required intubation and mechanical ventilation, and was treated with broad-spectrum antibiotics. After extubation and clinical improvement, he was weaned off oxygen, regained mobility with a cane, and was discharged home. His kidney injury and hyperglycemia resolved, and mental health concerns were addressed with follow-up arranged. Cocaine use was noted, and counseling was provided.
